messages:
Aisha (CEO): Thanks for joining the all-hands Q&A thread. Quick infra/capacity update from the slides — short summary: constrained A100 supply in us-west for ~6-8 weeks, spare A10/V100 capacity in eu-west and ap-southeast1. We rolled some autoscaler changes in canary. Drop questions here and we'll answer live. (slides: https://rdw.infra/slides/quarterly-infra)

Maya (Head of Capacity): TL;DR: ramping reserved capacity + burst pools. New autoscaler preference: reserved pools first, then burst. Target avg GPU utilization 65%-75% to balance cost and latency SLOs.

Diego (Infra): What's the plan for Dedicated customers pinned to A100? Any migration windows or guaranteed replacement hardware?

Maya (Head of Capacity): For Dedicated pinned to A100: 3 options — 1) keep current region and accept longer queue (we'll keep SLA/quota commitments), 2) migrate to tested A10-backed clusters (we'll run perf validations), 3) enable cross-region routing (us-west -> eu-west) with optional data-plane egress settings. We'll contact affected accounts by EOD with choices.

Sam (Eng-SRE): How will the autoscaler affect cold-starts for small chat requests? We're seeing tail latency spikes early in the day.

Maya (Head of Capacity): Autoscaler changes include: prespin warm pool for popular model variants, prefix KV cache seeding during warmup, and background micro-batching during spin-up. Expect ~40% reduction in cold-start P95/P99 for common chat flows.

Jin (Product): ap-southeast1 — what's the timeline for GA for Hosted API? A few customers keep asking.

Aisha (CEO): ap-southeast1 GA target mid-May. Need to finish network peering and KMS integration for Private customers first; dedicated rollouts follow.

Diego (Infra): Preferred instance family? still getting p4d requests from partners.

Maya (Head of Capacity): Preferred: A100 80GB where available; otherwise A10G for most transformer models; V100 for lighter workloads. Console shows model perf profiles and recommended instance family per model.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Ops question — how will you rollout the autoscaler? Canary with metrics/rollback?

Diego (Infra): Yes — canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% across customers. Auto-rollback if P99 latency > +15% or error rate spike. We'll add an ops dashboard: /ops/autoscaler with canary markers and current traffic split.

Maya (Head of Capacity): Quick action items: 1) infra will email the list of Dedicated customers impacted; 2) perf matrix + console doc updated by tomorrow; 3) follow-up office hours next Thu 10am PT. If you need raw numbers ping me or drop logs in #eng-infra.

Priya (Support): Noted — one SMB reported retries increased after 2026-03-12 deploy, tracking ticket #4523.

Maya (Head of Capacity): Thanks Priya — noted, please DM the logs or attach to the ticket. We'll include that in the canary watchlist.

All-Hands Bot: Recording + slides posted: https://rdw.infra/slides/quarterly-infra. Office hours invite sent to calendar.

Aisha (CEO): Thanks everyone. If you're an engineer with impacted workloads, drop a one-line note here with region/model and @Maya will follow up. :raised_hands:
